overview.text: Iran vowed to end the U.S. naval blockade by all available means, while Trump said Iran's attacks have done no damage.
Fighting between Russia and Ukraine is widening geographically, with Russian missiles landing in Poland and NATO's chief vowing defense against a reported nuclear satellite.
The longest UN climate talks on record ended with no deal as oil producers blocked language on phasing out fossil fuels.
An ICE arrest of a father and daughter at Seattle airport has drawn outrage and prompted the family to speak out.
Gaza meningitis cases rose to 272 in October, more than eight times the typical monthly rate, as Israeli strikes continued.
Ousted Bangladeshi leader Sheikh Hasina says she plans to return from exile on December 16.

stories.headline: ✅ Spurs 123, Kings 107
stories.summary: Final · at Kings · Record 15-3

stories.headline: Family speaks out after ICE arrests woman and father at Seattle airport
stories.summary: Jose Castillo says he felt useless watching his wife and father-in-law taken into federal custody at Seattle-Tacoma airport. Agents dragged the pair from a jet bridge door as they screamed for help.
stories.why: The arrest, caught on camera, has sparked outrage over how immigration enforcement is carried out.

stories.headline: Sheikh Hasina says she will return to Bangladesh on December 16
stories.summary: A spokesperson says the ousted Bangladeshi prime minister plans to return home from exile in India on Dec. 16.
stories.why: Her return could shake Bangladesh's politics.

stories.headline: FBI's second-ranking official reportedly retiring before year's end
stories.summary: Christopher Raia, a veteran agent and the FBI's No. 2 official, is said to be leaving. It comes a few months after another deputy departed.
stories.why: Turnover at the bureau's top ranks affects leadership stability.

stories.headline: Iran vows to end U.S. naval blockade by 'all available means'
stories.summary: Iran says it will force the U.S. to lift its blockade. Trump acknowledged Iran's increasing attacks but said they have done no damage.
stories.why: Escalation at sea risks a wider conflict.

stories.headline: Democrats probe businesses tied to Trump Jr.'s investment firm
stories.summary: Investigators say companies linked to 1789 Capital, Donald Trump Jr.'s investment firm, have profited since his father's reelection. Democrats are examining whether the businesses benefit from government access.

stories.headline: Top aviation officials were traveling when U.S. flights were halted
stories.summary: Transportation administrators and key executives of the contractor handling an equipment upgrade were in transit on Nov. 13, when flights were halted nationwide.
stories.why: It raises questions about oversight during the air-travel disruption.

stories.headline: Russia-Ukraine fighting widens, with missiles in Poland and Libya strike
stories.summary: Ukraine recently sank a Russian warship docked in Libya, and Russian missiles landed in Poland. The Kremlin has not commented on the missiles.
stories.why: The war is reaching further beyond Ukraine's borders.

stories.headline: NATO chief vows defense against space threats after nuclear satellite reports
stories.summary: German media reported Russia plans to launch a satellite carrying a nuclear warhead in coming weeks. NATO's chief pledged to defend against threats from space.

stories.headline: Gaza meningitis cases surge as Israeli strikes kill seven
stories.summary: Gaza health officials say meningitis cases reached 272 in October, more than eight times the typical monthly rate. Israeli air strikes killed seven people.
stories.why: Disease is compounding the humanitarian crisis.

stories.headline: Bipartisan objections to Trump's role in Huang's return to Nvidia
stories.summary: Republicans and Democrats object to Trump's role in Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO. Congress is expected to question Huang about ties to China and the intervention.
stories.why: It touches on AI chip exports and national security.

stories.headline: States sue SpaceX over Grok generating sexual images of children
stories.summary: State attorneys general say Grok still produces child sexual abuse material and revenge porn. X says every Grok output is screened.

stories.headline: SpaceX renting computing power to rivals complicates Musk's AI effort
stories.summary: SpaceX is renting computing capacity from its data centers to competitors including Anthropic, which makes it harder for Musk's own AI effort.

stories.headline: Longest-ever UN climate talks end with no deal
stories.summary: COP31 ended without agreement as deep divisions emerged. European and vulnerable nations rejected a draft after Saudi Arabia and other oil producers blocked any mention of phasing out coal, oil and gas.

stories.headline: Measles a growing risk for U.S. adults, experts say
stories.summary: The danger is greatest for the unvaccinated, but vaccinated people born before 1989 may no longer be sufficiently protected, medical experts said.
stories.why: Some adults may need to check their protection.

stories.headline: Doctors struggle as parents refuse newborn vitamin K shots
stories.summary: Doctors are fighting disinformation about routine vitamin K shots given to newborns, which prevent a rare but devastating bleeding disorder.
stories.why: Refusals put infants at risk of serious harm.

stories.headline: High fuel costs hit Thanksgiving travelers
stories.summary: A near-record number of people are expected to travel this Thanksgiving week, and they will be paying more to do so.
stories.why: Travel budgets are squeezed this holiday.

stories.headline: Young New Yorkers losing money on Kalshi, city council finds
stories.summary: A City Council investigation into prediction market companies found that 18- to 20-year-olds in New York City are losing money at a high rate.

stories.headline: Restaurants turn to AI and call services for phone reservations
stories.summary: New services, some AI-run and some staffed by people, are competing to answer restaurants' phone calls.

stories.headline: SEC schedules vote on possible LSU expulsion
stories.summary: LSU's standoff with the SEC over the RJ Luis dispute has escalated into a legal and political fight, with major penalties still possible.
stories.why: It could reshape college football's biggest conference.

stories.headline: Everton lose 4-0 at Brentford; Moyes questions Tarkowski red card
stories.summary: Everton collapsed at Brentford and now face a suspension problem. David Moyes questioned the red card shown to James Tarkowski.

stories.headline: Infantino's private-jet travel draws scrutiny amid World Cup stake plan
stories.summary: FIFA president Gianni Infantino has made 39 private-jet flights in 115 days since his plan to sell a World Cup stake came under scrutiny.

stories.headline: Police investigate substance that forced Manchester arena evacuation
stories.summary: Police are investigating an unknown substance that caused the evacuation of Co-op Live during a Don Toliver show. Attendees described a horrible smell and screaming.

stories.headline: First Children's Booker prize reveals shortlist and child judges
stories.summary: Eight books are in contention, including War by Eoin Colfer and Andrew Donkin.

stories.headline: King Charles and Elton John honor Australian music figure Molly Meldrum
stories.summary: The promoter and broadcaster, who helped shape Australians' music tastes for decades, was remembered by King Charles and Elton John.

today.summary: Cloudy today, with a high of 56° and a low of 43°. No rain expected.
